text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
As summer camp reached the halfway mark,
a night walk was organized as part of
the camp's recreational activities.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Though called a "night walk," it was practically a test of courage contest, and I ended up getting involved as a chaperone...

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Heheh...
It kinda gives that classic summer vibe...
Pretty nice, ain't it?

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: Ghost or whatever, bring it the hell on, dammit!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
"D-Don't talk nonsense!
Who do you think I am?!
There ain't nothing in this world that scares Lady Inari!"

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: Just you watch, I'll be back in no time with room to spare!

text_block_list.name: Staff Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
—Well then, we're gonna draw lots for pairs,
and you'll be making a round trip
from here to the destination and back~!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Inari One's partner turned out to be Tamamo Cross, a Kansai-born Umamusume renowned for her fierce competitive spirit and explosive closing speed.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Normally, both of them are cheerful, energetic,
and the dependable type who others rely on, but—

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: —L-Like hell I care! I know you're shaking in your boots! If you wanna run home with your tail between your legs, now's your chance, Tama!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
N-Nonsense, Inari!
Why don't you hurry back to your room,
wrap yourself in your futon, and bawl your eyes out!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Heheh...! You can talk all you want, but aren't your legs shaking?
It's totally obvious you're just bluffing...!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Ha...! Look who's talking! Isn't your own voice trembling?
Acting tough ain't foolin' nobody...!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: Nghhh...!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Grrr...!

text_block_list.name: Inari & Tamamo
text_block_list.text:
I ain't scared!
Not scared one bit!

text_block_list.name: Staff Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
“—Next up, the pair of Inari One and
Tamamo Cross will be departing~!”

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Both of their expressions are slightly stiff,
so I tried to think of some advice to ease their fear,
and what came to mind was—
choice_data_list: Shouting loudly will take your mind off it.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Y-Yeah, that might actually be good every now and then!
Feel free to yell as loud as you want anytime!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Aah?! That's my line!
You're the one who should be glad
I'm letting you yell louder than usual!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: And so, the two loudly set off—

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
—O-Ohoho! Now ain't this quite the atmospheric forest!
Nice, cool, and feels damn good!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Y-You got that right!
It's real quiet and calm, honest!
Aaah, so relaxing—

text_block_list.name: Noise
text_block_list.text: (Rustle, rustle, rustle...!)

text_block_list.name: Noise
text_block_list.text: (Chatter chatter chatter...!)

text_block_list.name: Inari & Tamamo
text_block_list.text: Hyaah...!!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Wha, what's your problem, Tama!
Don't let out such a ridiculous shriek!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Y-You're the one who sounds like she's about to burst into tears, Inari!

text_block_list.name: Noise
text_block_list.text: (Fwhooooosh......!)

text_block_list.name: Inari & Tamamo
text_block_list.text: Aaaahhh!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
What's the big deal?!
You got quite the loud voice there, Tama!
Guess you're totally freakin' out after all, huh?!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Shut up!!
You're the one yelling so loud my ears almost died!
Jeez, seriously, having a scaredy-cat around is bad for my heart!

text_block_list.name: Noise
text_block_list.text: (Rustle, whoooosh!!)

text_block_list.name: Inari & Tamamo
text_block_list.text: Aaaaahhh!!!!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
*pant*... *pant*...
F-Finally made it back, huh...â

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
*gasp*... *pant*...
I-I thought my throat was gonna give out...—

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: ......Oh, Tama.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: …………Inari.

text_block_list.name: Inari & Tamamo
text_block_list.text:
Let's just... let bygones be bygones for tonight...
Let's just... let bygones be bygones for tonight, okay...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: And so, Inari One and Tamamo Cross shared a secret summer memory together...

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
"Did you hear that, Tama?! Fine, I guess I'll
keep you company on your speed-walk!
You'd better be grateful!"

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Aah?! That's my line!
I'm keeping up with your front-running pace,
so you should be thanking me, Inari!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: And so, the two briskly set off—

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
—O-Ohoho! Now ain't this quite the atmospheric forest!
Nice, cool, and feels damn good!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Y-You got that right!
It's real quiet and calm, honest!
Aaah, so relaxing—

text_block_list.name: Noise
text_block_list.text: (Rustle, rustle, rustle...!)

text_block_list.name: Noise
text_block_list.text: (Chatter chatter chatter...!)

text_block_list.name: Inari & Tamamo
text_block_list.text: Hyaah...!!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Wha, what's your problem, Tama!
Don't let out such a ridiculous shriek!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Y-You're the one who sounds like she's about to burst into tears, Inari!

text_block_list.name: Noise
text_block_list.text: (Fwhooooosh......!)

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Heh, heheh...
It's fine, Tama.
You go right ahead and run away as fast as you can...!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Hah, that's enough of your cheek...!
I know full well that you wanna turn tail
and run right outta here too...!

text_block_list.name: Noise
text_block_list.text: (Rustle, whoooosh!!)

text_block_list.name: Inari & Tamamo
text_block_list.text: Nnnrgh!!!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
*pant*... *pant*...
Even I'm... worn out from that...â

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
*pant*... *wheeze*...
I really went and gave it everything I had...—

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: ......Oh, Tama.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: …………Inari.

text_block_list.name: Inari & Tamamo
text_block_list.text:
Let's just... let bygones be bygones for tonight...
Let's just... let bygones be bygones for tonight, okay...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: And so, Inari One and Tamamo Cross shared a secret summer memory together...
